name: Vajra Yogalaya (Lalitpur)
reason: Too thin: its own site (vajrayogalaya.com; robots.txt allows us) is a single page with anchor links only. Every class card repeats the same placeholder sentence, the only two dated events (a Vijay Kumar workshop on 8-9 May 2026 and a teacher training from 25 May 2026) have passed, and no class, training or price has a page of its own. Published contact: a Gmail address (Palina Tuladhar). Worth a look again if the site grows.
